speaker: NARRATOR
text: [wry] It caught on. Maybe a little too well.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quick, building] By the 1950s, "stress" was everywhere — magazines, medical journals, kitchen tables.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [laughs softly] Not quite. Selye gave us a word for something real. Your body really does respond to pressure — that part was a genuine discovery.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [lower, knowing] But a word that powerful is useful to people. And not only to scientists.
